title: Hold Menu
description: A shelf of records with an iOS-style long press that branches. Hold a cover and it lifts free on a spring while the shelf softens behind it; the menu opens beside it, and Add to Playlist and Share open real submenus, with Share going one level deeper into Messages and a contact. Submenus cascade out from the row that opened them with hover intent that forgives a diagonal reach, close back into it, and on a phone push in from the right with a back row. Slide and release to choose, or drive the whole tree with arrow keys, Enter and Escape.
intent: The context-menu moment finished to the edge, now with depth: every layer opens from and closes into the row it belongs to, the pointer can cut a corner toward a submenu without losing it, and the same tree reads as a stacked push and pop when there is no room to cascade.
